description: Election Commission - G. A. Sunil Priyarathne elected as Vice Chairman of the Maharagama Urban Council
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy for the Vice Chairman position in the Maharagama Urban Council under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes at the local government level, including the nomination and declaration of an elected official to fill a vacancy caused by death, which falls under the Elections classification (Type 7).
